title: Keep finite-time response distinct from a stationary tail
statement: The exact full system-field Ito identity uses waveform primitives F1,F2,their endpoint terms,actual O1=A_tO,O2=(partial_t+A_t)O1 and control-discontinuity contributions. Closed endpoints yield a drift/martingale second-order nuisance-response bound,not an all-orders finite-amplitude instrument theorem. The supplied passive-meter counterexample has stationary omega^-4 bulk response but emitted-plus-ringdown omega^-2 total due to nonclosing boundary primitive. Alternating completecycleorientation closes an extra scalar moment at equal duration/peakdetuning but makes the corrected-mean/Hessian joint calculation WORSE:rawCNOT .00221216vs.000706869,visibilityloss .00283620vs.000931806. Scalar closure does not cancel the full spectrum/common trajectory;the refinement is rejected at this regime,not a counterexample to the organising law.
